subject: Re: Kickoff: mucped22 — April status + metric-divergence finding
body:
Hi both,

Status: database ingested and the correlation baselines are done. Emeka's annotation UI v1 is live — pairwise views, qualification flow, and per-session quality checks all working — and Ondrej's pilot batch ran last week with 9 qualified raters.

The finding that matters: on compression-typical distortions, metric rankings disagree with each other far more than the legacy-database correlations would predict. MS-SSIM and the perceptual metrics agree on the easy cases, but on the multi-bitrate ladders they invert ordering on about 1 in 6 image pairs — and the pilot's human judgments side with different metrics in different distortion regimes. That's exactly the release's thesis: a metric tuned on KADID-style distortions is not trustworthy for codec tuning.

Risk/trade-off: the codec team wants a single blessed metric by May. The honest answer may be "metric X within this bitrate range, human eval outside it." Less convenient, more true.

Gustavo
